name: Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette
ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Aqua, Bergamot, Ambroxan, Pepper, Lavender
warnings: Flammable. Keep away from fire. Avoid contact with eyes. External use only.
warningRw: Itwika vuba. Wubike kure y'umuriro. Irinda guturika mu maso. Gusa hanze gusa.
instructions: Spray 2-3 times on pulse points (wrists, neck). Do not rub after applying.
instructionsRw: Funga inshuro 2-3 ku mubiri (ku biringiti, ku ijosi). Ntukanyure nyuma yo gushira.

name: Chanel No. 5 Eau de Parfum
ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Aqua, Ylang-Ylang, Rose, Jasmine, Sandalwood, Vanilla
warnings: Keep away from heat and direct sunlight. Flammable. For external use only.
warningRw: Wubike kure y'ubushyuhe n'izuba. Itwika. Gusa hanze gusa.
instructions: Apply to pulse points. Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
instructionsRw: Shira ku biringiti. Bika ahantu hacye, huma, kure y'izuba.

name: Dior Sauvage (Counterfeit)
ingredients: Unknown solvents, synthetic fixatives, possible allergens
warnings: COUNTERFEIT: Packaging mimics authentic Dior. May contain toxic solvents causing skin burns or allergic reactions.
warningRw: INYIGANANO: Agashya gasa na Dior nyayo. Irimo ibintu bishobora gusenya uruhu cyangwa gutera ubwivumbure.
instructions: DO NOT USE. Dispose safely and report to Rwanda FDA.
instructionsRw: NTUKORESHE. Buta neza maze umenyeshe Rwanda FDA.
